records.summary: APEDA reports rice exports of USD 12.47 billion and 20.19 million metric tonnes in FY2024/25. Historical exports indicate supply capability, not available stock.
Singapore imports more than 90% of food and sourced food from over 180 countries and regions in 2025. This is structural import dependence, not unmet orders.
Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development figures show 9.18 million tonnes of rice exports worth USD 5.75 billion in 2024.
records.source: Vietnam Industry and Trade Information Center

records.summary: Thailand exported 9.95 million tonnes of rice worth USD 6.69 billion in 2024. Indonesia took 1.33 million tonnes and Iraq 1 million tonnes.
Fishery exports reached USD 7.08 billion; canned tuna contributed USD 2.42 billion. Reported leading markets were the United States, Japan and China.
Pakistan Bureau of Statistics reports textile-manufacture exports of USD 16.656 billion in FY2024. This is a historical annual baseline.
BGMEA's calendar-year table reports 2025 apparel exports of USD 38,824.71 million, comprising woven and knit apparel.
All India Radio reports the RBI survey total of USD 221.4 billion in software-services exports in FY2025/26, up 8.2% year on year.
IBPAP reports USD 38 billion of industry revenue and 1.82 million jobs in 2024. Revenue is industry size, not a verified export-only total.
records.source: IT and Business Process Association of the Philippines

records.summary: MHLW reports 2,571,037 foreign workers, up 11.7% year on year, at end-October 2025. Employed-worker stock signals established demand; it is not a vacancy count.
records.source: Japan Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare

records.summary: Japan's official employment notifications record 605,906 Vietnamese workers. This measures an existing labor corridor, not workers available for recruitment.
records.source: Japan Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare

records.summary: Japan's official employment notifications record 260,869 Filipino workers; this is an observed employment corridor, not current recruitment availability.
records.source: Japan Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare

records.summary: JASSO counted 336,708 international students across higher education, language institutes and other surveyed institutions on 1 May 2024. This is enrollment, not open seats.

EMGS publishes quarterly international student application statistics by origin and study level. The inspected portal identifies Q3 2026; numeric totals were not extracted and are intentionally omitted.
MCST's cultural-industry export table records music exports of USD 1.801449 billion in 2024, compared with USD 1.222535 billion in 2023.
records.source: Republic of Korea Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

records.summary: MCST's cultural-industry table records film exports of USD 114.4 million in 2024, below USD 124.798 million in 2023.
records.source: Republic of Korea Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

records.summary: China Film Administration reports more than CNY 42.5 billion box-office revenue in 2024. Domestic films accounted for 78.68%; total box office is consumer demand, not import demand.
NUS SCALE publishes a short-course catalog and application portal, including stackable lifelong-learning pathways. Course dates and eligibility require provider confirmation.
BGMEA's monthly table reports September 2026 RMG exports of USD 3,082.95 million, up 8.56% from September 2025. Monthly flow is not a three-month forecast.

Thailand's official rice-export release identifies Indonesia as its largest market in 2024 at 1.33 million tonnes. This historical bilateral flow does not establish current import permission or orders.

news.title: WTO raises merchandise-trade outlook, with AI-related goods supporting growth

news.title: Singapore tests readiness for food supply disruptions
news.summary: SFA conducted an operational exercise to strengthen preparedness for potential food supply disruptions. The announcement describes readiness work, not an actual shortage.

news.title: ADB September outlook projects 5.0% regional growth in 2026
news.summary: ADB projects developing Asia and the Pacific growth of 5.0% in 2026 and 5.1% in 2027; prolonged conflict and El Niño create cost and supply uncertainty.

news.title: Ecobank merencanakan akses CIPS untuk transaksi yuan
